cohort: Singleton pregnancies in Victoria, Australia between 2009 and 2017 (n=636,590)
finding: The use of elective caesarean section and induction of labor in PPROM is rising in Victoria, particularly between 34 and 36 completed weeks of pregnancy.
mod_finding: For women with PPROM at 34-36 weeks the odds of elective caesarean section increased by 5% annually and 2% for induction of labor vs expectant management.
